title.en: Air Navigation (Exemption for Project KESTREL) Order 2026

completenessNote: 全文，共 7 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 3 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en:
1.—(1) This Order is the Air Navigation (Exemption for Project KESTREL) Order 2026.
(2) This Order is in force for the period between 21 September 2026 and 20 September 2027 (both dates inclusive).

THIRD SCHEDULE
Paragraph 4(e)
Reportable safety matters
1. An accident involving a JMS, including a collision with an unmanned aircraft.
2. A near collision of a JMS with another thing or an individual.
3. An incident that occurs during a flight or an operation of a JMS which has a high potential of causing an accident.
4. A JMS unintentionally flying into any terrain or obstacle while it is in operation and under control.
5. A difficulty in piloting or operating a JMS, including an uncontrolled approach or descent of the JMS.
6. An incapacitation of an individual while the individual pilots or operates a JMS.
7. A fire or smoke event, including an event where the fire was extinguished.
8. A failure of, or significant damage to, any structure of a JMS, a disintegration of any part of the engine or external part of the JMS, or an uncontained failure of the turbine engine of the JMS.
9. A malfunction that seriously affected the flight or operation of a JMS, including —
(a)a shutdown of an engine of the JMS; and
(b)any unintentional deviation of airspeed, intended track or altitude of the JMS.
10. Any circumstances requiring an individual who is piloting or operating a JMS to avoid colliding with another aircraft, other than a near collision mentioned in paragraph 2.
11. A loss of communication between an individual piloting or operating a JMS and the ground support crew assisting the individual in piloting or operating the JMS.
12. An incident that causes, or could cause, damage to a JMS including —
(a)a lightning strike on a JMS; and
(b)a bird strike on a JMS.
13. An abnormality in the operating system or engine vibration of a JMS.
14. A use of incorrect or contaminated fuel, oil or other fluid for a JMS.
15. An incident involving a JMS being flown or operated outside a specified area.
16. An occurrence, other than any occurrence mentioned in paragraphs 1 to 15, that involves a JMS and endangers or may endanger the operation of another aircraft, or which causes or may cause a danger to any person or property.
